key_drivers.name: Riyadh airport fuel-storage area hit amid Houthi escalation
key_drivers.observed: Reuters imagery identified smoke from a fuel-storage depot at King Khalid International Airport after Houthi strikes; Saudi civil defence issued and later lifted danger alerts around Riyadh and Al-Kharj.
key_drivers.interpretation: Extends the Middle East conflict's infrastructure-risk footprint into the Saudi capital and increases aviation, fuel, insurance and logistics risk; no unverified production-loss quantity is assumed.

key_drivers.name: Black Sea commercial-vessel attacks reported
key_drivers.observed: Interfax, citing Russia's Defence Ministry, reported strikes on a Ukrainian cargo ship in the Black Sea and a tanker at a Ukrainian port; Reuters could not independently verify the battlefield report.
key_drivers.interpretation: Reinforces the already-widened Black Sea war-risk designation and supports higher marine-insurance and freight risk, with reduced confidence due to lack of independent verification.

key_drivers.name: U.S. Taiwan arms-package delay persists
key_drivers.observed: Anduril founder Palmer Luckey told Reuters that the U.S. delay in approving a roughly $14 billion Taiwan arms package is affecting its business and that he discussed it with President Trump.
key_drivers.interpretation: Confirms persistent Taiwan security-policy uncertainty ahead of renewed U.S.-China talks; it does not mean the package has been cancelled.
